name: tekjobs
description: A local-first job-search machine: scans hundreds of company boards every morning, scores every posting against criteria you own, files matches as Markdown notes, and lets your own LLM run the search over MCP. Employers post into the same scan.

paragraphs: A local career memory for you and your AI. TekJobs scans hundreds of public company job boards every morning, scores each posting against criteria you control, and saves the results as readable markdown files on your machine. Connect it to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or Claude Desktop over MCP and your agent can weigh roles, prepare truthful application material and track the search, without ever making the final submission.
Website · Getting started · Connect your AI client · npm · Releases · Ideas and questions

What it does, in forty-five seconds. Watch the showreel (mp4, vertical and square cuts). For one real, unedited run on the fictional sample resume (install, interview, first scan, first Today), watch the 57-second demo.

requirements.text: All public; the company-board scan needs no API key.
It has no account and keeps no hosted copy of those records.
A request through Tailscale gets in only with a login you name in /.tekjobs/config.json ("allowedLogins": ["you@example.com"]); the list starts empty.
